title: Article 316 — Appointment and term of office of members

content.overview: Article 316 provides that the Chairman and other members of a Public Service Commission shall be appointed, in the case of the UPSC or a Joint Commission, by the President, and in the case of a State Commission, by the Governor of the State. As nearly as may be, one-half of the members of every Commission shall be persons who at the dates of their respective appointments have held office for at least ten years under the Government of India or of a State. Term is six years or until the age of sixty-five (UPSC) or sixty-two (SPSC), whichever is earlier.
content.glance: UPSC/Joint: appointed by President. SPSC: by Governor. ~½ members with ≥10 years government office. Term: 6 years or age 65 (UPSC) / 62 (SPSC).
content.study:
Article 316 appointment and tenure:
- Appointing authority: President (UPSC, Joint Commission); Governor (SPSC).
- Composition preference: as nearly as may be one-half with ≥10 years’ office under Union or State Government.
- Term: six years or until 65 (UPSC) / 62 (SPSC), whichever earlier.
- Post-office employment restrictions as specified in the article.

Examination: who appoints; half with government experience; term and age ceilings.

sections.heading: Key rules
sections.body:
1. Appointment: President (UPSC/Joint); Governor (SPSC).
2. As nearly as may be one-half: ≥10 years’ government office.
3. Term: 6 years or age 65 (UPSC) / 62 (SPSC), whichever earlier.

questionsAndAnswers.question: How are members of Public Service Commissions appointed and for how long?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Under Article 316, the Chairman and other members of the UPSC or a Joint Commission are appointed by the President, and those of a State Commission by the Governor of the State. As nearly as may be, one-half of the members shall be persons who have held office for at least ten years under the Government of India or of a State. A member holds office for six years from the date of entering upon office or until the age of sixty-five (UPSC) or sixty-two (SPSC), whichever is earlier.

examTips: President/Governor appoint; 6 years or 65/62; ~½ with 10 years’ govt service.

keyTakeaways: Art 316: PSC appointment, term, and composition preference.
